formyl group modifications are a major evolutionary mechanism for Chls in oxygenic photosynthetic organisms and that the formyl groups of the macrocycle are a major determinant of the light absorption properties of these pigments.

formyl group modification of Chl a may be an important mechanism in chlorophyll evolution.
